downloadIntro.zh: Windows 版已更新至 v1.57.50，Mac 版当前为 v1.57.35。请选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: Windows is now v1.57.50; the current Mac release is v1.57.35. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 扩充绘图工具：新增多种线条、通道、分叉线、斐波那契、江恩、形态、艾略特波浪及周期工具，同时补充旋转矩形、曲线、箭头和文字注释等工具。
highlights.en: More drawing tools: new lines, channels, pitchforks, Fibonacci and Gann studies, chart patterns, Elliott waves and cycles, plus rotated rectangles, curves, arrows and annotations.

highlights.zh: 激光笔：笔迹随绘制逐渐消失，适合讲解和临时标记；支持调整颜色、粗细及多种拖尾样式。
highlights.en: A laser pointer with fading strokes for explanations and temporary highlights. Adjust its colour, width and tail style.

highlights.zh: 行情推演工具：支持复制已有 K 线形态、绘制模拟 K 线，以及在图表上添加交易计划表格。
highlights.en: Explore chart scenarios by copying existing bars, drawing simulated candles and adding trading-plan tables to the chart.

highlights.zh: 成交量分析工具：新增锚定 VWAP 和固定范围成交量分布，后者基于当前图表周期的 K 线数据估算。
highlights.en: Anchored VWAP and fixed-range volume profile drawing tools. The volume profile is estimated from bars at the current chart timeframe.

highlights.zh: 绘图对象树：支持搜索、重命名、分组，以及批量隐藏、锁定、删除和调整图层顺序。
highlights.en: A drawing object tree with search, renaming, groups, bulk hide/lock/delete actions and layer ordering.

highlights.zh: 回放价格提醒与时间定位线：价格触及时提示，可选择自动暂停回放；时间定位线在切换周期后保持对应时间位置。
highlights.en: Replay price alerts can pause playback when triggered. Pinned time lines keep their timestamp when you change timeframe.

highlights.zh: 会员推荐入口：终身会员可查看和复制推荐码、查看推荐等级，并进入推荐返利页面；支持推荐优惠兑换。
highlights.en: Lifetime members can view and copy their referral code, check their referral level and open the referral rewards page. Referral-price voucher redemption is supported.

highlights.zh: 绘图工具栏重新设计：同类工具分组收纳，记住组内选择；第一次点击选中工具，再次点击展开菜单。图标更紧凑，支持滚轮和按住鼠标拖动浏览。
highlights.en: A redesigned drawing toolbar groups related tools and remembers your selection. Click once to select a tool and again to open its group. Compact icons, wheel scrolling and drag scrolling fit smaller screens.

highlights.zh: 完善绘图属性设置：新增可拖动浮动属性栏，设置按“样式、文字、坐标、可见范围”分类；支持外观模板、坐标编辑和分周期显示，并细化层级、填充及标签设置。
highlights.en: A draggable floating properties bar and settings organised into Style, Text, Coordinates and Visibility. Save appearance templates, edit coordinates, choose visible timeframes and fine-tune levels, fills and labels.

highlights.zh: 文字可直接在图上编辑：趋势线等线条选中后可添加文字，文字沿线方向显示在线条上方；斐波那契档位及常用形状也支持直接编辑文字。
highlights.en: Edit text directly on the chart. Selected trend lines and other lines can show text above and parallel to the stroke; Fibonacci levels and common shapes support inline text editing too.

highlights.zh: 完善绘图辅助操作：支持强弱磁吸、临时切换磁吸、Shift 角度约束，以及单个图形的复制、克隆、锁定和隐藏。
highlights.en: Strong and weak magnets, temporary magnet switching, Shift angle constraints, and per-drawing copy, clone, lock and hide controls.

highlights.zh: 扩充右键与删除菜单：增加重置视图、复制价格、粘贴画线、对象树、模板和设置入口；可分别清除绘图、指标或同时清除，并选择是否包含锁定绘图。
highlights.en: Expanded chart context and removal menus offer view reset, price copying, drawing paste, object tree, templates and settings. Remove drawings, indicators or both, with an option to include locked drawings.

highlights.zh: 修复连续绘图时属性栏、设置窗口自动消失的问题，优化菜单展开高度和文字布局。
highlights.en: Fixed properties and settings closing during continuous drawing; improved expanded menu height and text placement.

highlights.zh: 修复多窗口下双击价格轴恢复比例时，误触发窗口放大的问题。
highlights.en: Fixed double-clicking the price axis to reset its scale accidentally maximising a chart pane.

highlights.zh: 修正复盘习惯统计：按连续复盘场次计算次数和单次平均时长，短时间重启合并计算，保留原有累计时长。
highlights.en: Review habits now count continuous review sessions and their average duration, merging brief app restarts while preserving recorded time.

highlights.zh: 修正 S3 云备份状态提示与自动刷新冲突；恢复密钥不匹配时，支持导入配置并在新目录重新开始备份。
highlights.en: Corrected S3 backup status messages and automatic refresh conflicts. If recovery keys do not match, settings can be imported to start fresh in a new backup folder.
